channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Landmark ruling linked to increased cross-state travel for abortion care
item.description: A large cohort study assessed population-level data before and after the Dobbs v Jackson decision, finding changes in abortion care patterns.

item.title: Oral anticoagulants benefit intermediate-risk atrial fibrillation patients
item.description: In patients with atrial fibrillation at intermediate stroke risk, oral anticoagulant therapy reduced adverse clinical events compared to no treatment.

item.title: Txn1 mutant rats: A translational model for chronic kidney disease
item.description: Chronic kidney disease affects about one in ten adults globally. Despite improved treatments, many patients still face challenges, and this model may aid research.

item.title: Silent artery plaques may appear in one in 13 adults before age 30
item.description: An international study shows atherosclerosis begins long before symptoms, with silent plaques potentially present in young adults.
